title: Stay awake over what the Guru has given
summary: This meets the inattentive mind that asks for guidance and then drifts. The line says asking the Guru is not enough; you must stay awake enough to guard the field.
takeaway: Guard the field of the mind.
lifeApplication: Before another distracted hour slips by, notice where your attention has wandered. Return to the line and protect what the Guru already planted.

source.shortMeaning: Ask the Guru, then stay awake enough to guard what has been entrusted.
source.lifeApplication: When attention strays, come back quickly before the field is picked over again.
